senses.gloss: f. (Saturnalia) the Saturnalia, a Roman festival beginning on the 17ᵗʰ of December and lasting several days.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 1:3">Ab. Zar. I, 3</cite> Y. ed. (Mish. a. Bab. ed. 8ᵃ variously corrupted or perverted). Y. ib. 39ᶜ (cacophemistic etymology) <he>שׁנאה טֹמונה שׁונא נוקם ונ̇וט̇ר̇</he> hatred hidden (under the merriment of social equality and good will), he (the Roman) hates &c. Ib. <he>ס׳ דביישן</he> the Saturnalian fair of Scythopolis (v. <cite ref="B00746"><he>בֵּישָׁן</he></cite>). Ib. top <he>ס׳ אינה אסורה וכ׳</he> during the Saturnalia trading is forbidden only with those who worship thereon (celebrate it). Bab. ib. 8ᵃ <he>ס׳ שמונה ימים לפני וכ׳</he> the Saturnalia begin eight days before the solstice; Y. l. c. <he>ס׳ לאחר וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 7">Deut. R. s. 7</cite> <cite ref="O00506"><he>סטרגלים</he></cite>, <he>סטרנלים</he> (corr. acc.).
